The '''''Nihilist''''' was a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] used as a flagship by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]&ndash;allied [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] forces that [[Rebellion on Felucia|occupied]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in preparation for an [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The ''Nihilist'' was destroyed when two Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] successfully raided it with the intent of rescuing their Master, [[Mavra Zane]], who had been [[Attack on Kashyyyk|captured]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Together the Jedi destroyed the ship's [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]]. They escape, but [[Star Runner|their starship]] crashed on Felucia.

==Characteristics==
Its hangar was protected by [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], and if breached, a door would close on it. Sector 7G was accessible from an elevator in the hangar, and it was a restricted area. The main reactor was on Level [[1138 (easter egg)|1138]], and a claw fed energy into the reactor. It could be destroyed by overloading it.

The prison level had several cells, and had a walkway leading to the central area.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Nihilist'' appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of the [[2012]] [[Wikipedia:Kinect|Kinect]]-exclusive [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
